headline: It's Fed decision day: bitcoin is back above $80,000 ahead of the 2:00pm ET announcement, Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% last quarter, and Korean exchange Bithumb disclosed a breach of its internal groupware system.

market.asOf: BTC and ETH read from KuCoin's daily market report, data as of 00:00 UTC Wed 28 Oct (07:00 Bangkok). 24h changes and SOL are left out because no page confirmed them this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 51 (previous 48) on the Fear & Greed Index per KuCoin's daily market report, data as of 00:00 UTC 28 Oct; the report does not name the provider.

stories.title: Fed decision day: bitcoin back above $80,000 ahead of the announcement
stories.summary: The Fed announces its interest-rate decision at 2:00pm ET today (01:00 Thursday Bangkok), and most of the market expects no change. Bitcoin is back above $80,000 after dipping below it earlier this week. Inflation and growth data follow on Thursday and a large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Bitcoin was at $80,908 and ether at $2,350 as of 00:00 UTC Wednesday, per KuCoin's daily report.
The Fed's range is 3.75-4.00%; CME FedWatch showed 90.6% odds of a hold on 27 Oct, per Bloomingbit. No new Fed projections are due until December, per Newsquawk.
About $149M of leveraged crypto bets were liquidated in 24 hours, $99.9M of them shorts (bets on a fall), per CoinGlass data reported by ChainCatcher.
September PCE inflation and the first estimate of Q3 GDP are both due Thursday at 8:30am ET, per crypto.news.
Friday's Deribit bitcoin options expiry is estimated at about $11B to $12B, with 'max pain' estimates of $76,000 to $79,000, per FinanceFeeds. Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue falls 55% even as total revenue hits a record
stories.summary: Robinhood reported its July-September results after Tuesday's close. Total revenue was a record, but crypto trading revenue more than halved from a year earlier, and prediction markets now bring in more than crypto. The stock fell after hours.
points: Total revenue rose 12% from a year earlier to $1.42B, just under the $1.43B analysts expected, per the company's release and Investing.com.
Crypto revenue was $120M, down 55%, on crypto trading volume of $50B, down 38%. Event contract (prediction market) revenue was $173M, more than 6x a year earlier, per the company's release.
Reported earnings were $0.51 a share, down 16%, and net income fell 14% to $476M, per the company's release; adjusted earnings were $0.60 against a $0.55 estimate, per Investing.com.
Funded customers rose 7% to 28.7M, per the company's release.
Shares fell 7.36% after hours to $87.60 from a $94.56 close, per Investing.com.

stories.title: Korean exchange Bithumb hacked as cyberattacks spread across Korean finance
stories.summary: Bithumb, one of South Korea's largest crypto exchanges, said an outsider broke into the internal mobile app its staff use for work on 27 Oct and personal data leaked. It reported the breach to regulators the same day. No report says customer crypto was taken. Brokerage Daishin Securities and two Mirae Asset companies also reported attacks.
points: Bithumb said the leaked data found so far is mainly employee data, but it has not ruled out customer data and has given no count, per Digital Today.
Bithumb reported the breach to KISA, Korea's internet security agency, and the Personal Information Protection Commission, per Digital Today.
Daishin Securities said data on 38,490 customers leaked; Mirae Asset Global Investments and Mirae Asset Life also reported intrusions, per The Korea Times.
No funds or private keys have been reported stolen so far, per SpendNode.

briefs.title: New Zealand surprises with a rate hold
briefs.summary: New Zealand's central bank kept its rate at 2.75% in a 4-3 vote when markets had expected a hike, and said tighter policy is still likely to be needed, per investingLive.

briefs.title: Ripple wins final approval for its US trust bank
briefs.summary: The OCC, the US regulator for national banks, gave final approval to Ripple National Trust Bank, which will manage the reserves behind Ripple's roughly $2.6B RLUSD stablecoin, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs took in $110M on Monday
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $110.3M on 26 Oct after outflows of $635.6M on 22 Oct and $137.9M on 23 Oct, per Farside. Tuesday's figures were not yet published.

briefs.title: USDC supply shrinks by $4B in a month
briefs.summary: USDC in circulation fell $4.08B over 30 days to $71.30B, per DefiLlama data reported by CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent plans regulated perpetuals on Hyperliquid
briefs.summary: Hyperliquid says Payward, Kraken's parent, will be the first CFTC-regulated deployer of its HIP-3 markets; the plan still needs regulatory approval, per The Block.

briefs.title: OCC invites community banks to issue stablecoins
briefs.summary: The OCC encouraged community banks to apply to issue stablecoins under the GENIUS Act; it is not yet accepting applications, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy paused bitcoin buying last week
briefs.summary: Strategy made no bitcoin purchases in the week to 25 Oct, per The Crypto Times.

briefs.title: Suspected exploit at Predict Fun
briefs.summary: On-chain trackers flagged suspected unauthorized outflows of more than $300K from Predict Fun, a prediction market on BNB Chain; the team had not confirmed the cause, per The Crypto Times.

calendar.note: Rate 2.25%; a hike to 2.50% is about 80% priced (Newsquawk), about 85% per BBH. Strategy holds a special shareholder meeting at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok).
Range 3.75-4.00%; a hold is expected (CME FedWatch 90.6% on 27 Oct, per Bloomingbit). Chair Warsh's press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok). No new projections until December (Newsquawk).

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (first estimate) and September PCE inflation
calendar.note: GDP forecasts: 3.0% (Newsquawk), 3.2% (BBH); prior 2.2%. PCE 3.6% a year expected, prior 3.4%; core 3.1%, prior 3.0% (Newsquawk). ECB decision 9:15am ET (20:15 Bangkok), hold expected.
Both report after the US close. Coinbase EPS consensus -$0.23 and revenue $1.21B (MarketBeat); CoinDesk lists -$0.10. Token unlocks the same day: FF and CARDS, per the unlock data on this page.
At 08:00 UTC. Estimated at about $11B to $12B, with max pain between $76,000 and $79,000 (FinanceFeeds). Max pain is not a price target.

calendar.event: US Employment Cost Index (Q3) and Chicago PMI
calendar.note: ECI 0.8% expected, prior 0.9%. Chicago PMI 9:45am ET (20:45 Bangkok), 55.8 expected, prior 58.8 (TradingCharts). Fed's Daly speaks at 12:00pm ET and Musalem at 12:30pm ET (Kiplinger).

calendar.note: ISM prior 54.5 (ISM). RBA decides at 10:30pm ET (10:30 Tue Bangkok): rate 4.60%, with 56.75% odds of a rise (RBA Rate Watch).
